q1.question: Do I need an account to take a quiz?
q1.answer: No. Anyone with the link can take a public quiz. You only need an account to create and manage quizzes.

q2.question: Which question types are supported?
q2.answer: You can mix multiple-choice, true/false and other question types in the same quiz.

q3.question: Can I set a time limit?
q3.answer: Yes. Set a time limit for the whole quiz or leave it open, whatever suits your test.

q4.question: How do I see my participants' results?
q4.answer: Open the submissions dashboard to see every attempt, score and completion time in one place.

q5.question: Can I keep a quiz private?
q5.answer: Yes. Only quizzes you publish appear in the public list. Private quizzes are reachable only by the people you share the link with.
